question: Where did the 18th 'Suryakiran' military exercise between India and Nepal commence?
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **18th Exercise Surya Kiran**: India-Nepal joint military exercise commenced on January 1, 2025, at the Nepal Army Battle School, Saljhandi, in the Shivalik ranges, and will run until January 13.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Objective**: The exercise aims to enhance **interoperability** in **Counter-Terrorism (CT) Operations**, jungle warfare, mountain warfare, and humanitarian assistance, focusing on **operational preparedness**, aviation aspects, medical training, and environmental conservation.
 
• **Personnel involved**: **334 Indian Army personnel** from the **11th Gorkha Rifles** are participating, alongside Nepalese forces.
 
• **Bilateral Relations**: The exercise strengthens **India-Nepal military ties**, following visits by **Chief of Army Staff General Upendra Dwivedi** and **Nepali Army Chief General Ashok Raj Sigdel**.
